rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people, acts, or methods involving physical force.

example.english: This film has a lot of violent scenes.
example.traditional: 呢套戲有好多暴力場面。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau5 hou2 do1 bou6 lik6 coeng4 min6

rows.note: Use 勁 in casual speech for forceful motion or something very severe, such as a headache.

example.english: I have a violent headache today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 go3 tau4 tung3 dak1 hou2 ging6

rows.note: Use this for intensely vivid colours or other strongly expressed impressions.

example.english: That poster uses a violent shade of red.
example.traditional: 呢張海報用咗強烈嘅紅色。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 jung6 zo2 koeng4 lit6 ge3 hung4 sik1

rows.note: Use this more precise formal term for acute or extreme pain, especially in medical contexts.

example.english: The doctor said this violent pain needs immediate treatment.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢種劇烈痛楚要即刻處理。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 zung2 kek6 lit6 tung3 co2 jiu3 zik1 hak1 cyu2 lei5
